query:
SELECT 'senate' as chamber, state_code, state_name, status, called_winner, called_party, primary_winner, is_special FROM senate_races WHERE status IN ('Called','Certified') OR called_winner IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'house', state_code, state_name, status, called_winner, called_party, primary_winner, false FROM house_races WHERE status IN ('Called','Certified') OR called_winner IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'governor', state_code, state_name, status, called_winner, called_party, NULL, is_special FROM governor_races WHERE status IN ('Called','Certified') OR called_winner IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY chamber, state_code;
